FROM races AS T1
INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2."XCL_074" = T1."XCL_065"

LIMIT 1

INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2."XCL_074" = T1."XCL_065"
INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3."XCL_034" = T2."XCL_075"
WHERE T3."XCL_041" = 'German'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T3."XCL_040") BETWEEN '1980' AND '1990'
  AND T1."XCL_066" = 2017
  AND T2."XCL_088" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (CAST(SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_088", 1, INSTR(T2."XCL_088", ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60)
       + (CAST(SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_088", INSTR(T2."XCL_088", ':') + 1, INSTR(T2."XCL_088", '.') - INSTR(T2."XCL_088", ':') - 1) AS REAL))
       + (CAST(SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_088", INSTR(T2."XCL_088", '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000)
LIMIT 1
